'''Two-hand''' was a [[Gambling/Legends|game of chance]]. It was available to play at the [[Saber's Tooth]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Taskeed/Legends|Taskeed]] alongside [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], [[Nierer's folly]], and [[dootch]].<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Crimson Bounty}}</ref>
